classification: MODELED INTERVENTION — not a biological lesion claim
operation: set executable weights to zero in memory only; retain topology, body IDs, raw contact counts, and compiled files
selection: source body belongs to accepted LC4 or LPLC2 port and target body belongs to accepted DNp01 port
effect_criterion: DNp01 total spike count changes, ordered first-spike tick changes by at least one 0.5 ms tick, or response presence differs
prohibition: do not strengthen or replace this intervention after observing calibration results
